title: FLARE: Toward Universal Dataset Purification against Backdoor Attacks
reasoning: The paper is a technical research study focused on a security defense method (dataset purification) for deep neural networks against backdoor attacks. It evaluates its proposed method, FLARE, using image classification benchmarks (CIFAR-10 and Tiny-ImageNet) and does not involve any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
